title: GoldAI decision file
description: One AI trading decision for the GoldAIBridge MT5 EA. Times are UTC ISO-8601.

version.description: Schema version. EA v1 accepts version >= 1 and reads known fields.

generated_at.description: UTC time this file was written, e.g. 2026-11-12T18:30:00Z

valid_until.description: UTC expiry. The EA ignores the file after this time (treats it as stale).

symbol.description: Logical symbol, usually XAUUSD or GOLD. The EA maps broker suffixes such as XAUUSDm.

bias.description: Trade direction. NONE means stay flat. A flip vs an open trade cancels that trade.

entry_zone.description: Market orders are allowed only when bid/ask is inside [low, high]. low must be < high when bias is BUY or SELL.

stop_loss.description: Absolute price. For BUY must sit below the zone; for SELL, above the zone.

take_profits.description: [tp1, tp2]. EA closes a fraction at tp1 and moves SL to breakeven; the remainder targets tp2. If only tp1 is set, it is used as the order TP and no partial is taken.

confidence.description: 0-100. EA will not open a trade if this is below its MinConfidence input (default 60).

max_risk_pct.description: Optional per-trade risk percent override. The EA caps this at its own RiskPercentPerTrade input. 0 or omitted means use the EA default.

rationale.description: Short reason, shown on the chart panel and written to the journal.

news_blackout.description: UTC windows where the EA must not open new trades. Open trades are still managed.

kill_switch.description: If true, the EA will not open new trades and will close any open GoldAI positions.
